description.en:
Bans one Special Move of one player for the match, or lifts the ban. A story match uses it to keep the opponent from using their strongest moves until a scripted beat.
Bans are stored as (player, move) pairs, 64 at most. When the game builds the list of moves a player can choose in a clash, each move gets a usable flag: it is false when the player lacks the TP, and also when that (player, move) pair is banned. So a banned move cannot be chosen.
With false, the matching pair is removed. CMND_BTL_RESET_SKILL_BAN removes all of them, and the list is also emptied when the match is cleaned up.
true to ban the move, false to lift the ban.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0088".
Always null (also when fewer than 3 arguments are given).

examples.case: Banning the opponent's shots before the match, lifting the bans in a later beat (real usage, from btl0004.nut)
